entities.summary: The Čemaluša Mosque, also known as the Havadža Kemaludin Mosque, was a former mosque located in Sarajevo, in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Completed in the 16th century, during the Ottoman era, the mosque was situated between Ferhadija street and Maršala Tito street and was located at the corner of the street with the same name, Čemaluša.
